q1_issues.issue: "brown" is a descriptive (colour) modifier on a plural, which the instruction set says distributes over the members via the per-member rule ranging over (PartOf $x sk_group_1); (Member sk_group_1 brown) instead predicates brown of the group-as-object, the reading the Quantifiers section explicitly warns against.

notes: Not fusing brown_ball / red_basket is correct (incidental colour), and LocatedIn is the right static head since there is no eventuality for Location to attach to; "some" is the existential wording, so no CardinalityPhrase is owed.
